_readme: huitong1929.com Schema Markup — 2026-06-17。分四個區塊：homepage / product_template / article_template / breadcrumb_*。靜態範例可直接貼入 Google Rich Results Test 驗證，Liquid 模板貼入 EasyStore 主題。

homepage._note: 貼入首頁 <head> 或 theme.liquid 的 {% if template == 'index' %} 區塊

Organization.name: 惠穀實業有限公司

logo._note: 請替換為實際 logo 圖片完整 URL，建議 600×60px 以上

Organization.description: 創立於1929年的迪化街百年老店，專注天然穀物、機能米與醬料食用油，現為第四代經營。

product_template._note: 貼入 product.liquid 或 theme.liquid 的 {% if template == 'product' %} 區塊。靜態範例以「穀和滿福養生十穀米」為例；Liquid 版本供套用全站。

static_example.name: 【大稻埕惠通行】穀和滿福 養生十穀米 600g｜嚴選蓮子糙薏仁配方｜全家均衡營養主食 (真空包裝)
static_example.description: 600g真空包裝養生十穀米，嚴選糙米、燕麥粒、去芯蓮子、紅薏仁與芡實等十種優質穀物。富含膳食纖維與多種微量元素，低負擔特性有助於平穩釋放能量，提供均衡完整的營養，讓全家大小都吃得健康又滿足。

offers._availability_note: 有庫存時改為 https://schema.org/InStock；售完時為 OutOfStock

liquid_template._note: 貼入 EasyStore product.liquid。變數名稱以 EasyStore 平台文件為準，price 單位請確認（若為分則除以100）
liquid_template._raw_liquid: {% assign product_availability = 'https://schema.org/OutOfStock' %}{% if product.available %}{% assign product_availability = 'https://schema.org/InStock' %}{% endif %}<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Product","name":{{ product.title | json }},"description":{{ product.description | strip_html | truncate: 300 | json }},"image":{{ product.featured_image | img_url: 'master' | prepend: 'https:' | json }},"brand":{"@type":"Brand","name":"惠通行"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":{{ shop.url | append: product.url | json }},"priceCurrency":"TWD","price":{{ product.price | money_without_currency | remove: ',' | json }},"availability":{{ product_availability | json }},"seller":{"@type":"Organization","name":"惠穀實業有限公司"}}}</script>

article_template._note: 貼入 article.liquid 或 theme.liquid 的 {% if template == 'article' %} 區塊。靜態範例以「食用油發煙點」文章為例。

static_example.headline: 食用油發煙點完整解析：10種常用油的用途與挑選指南

liquid_template._note: 貼入 EasyStore article.liquid。datePublished/dateModified 格式需為 ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD)。
liquid_template._raw_liquid: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Article","headline":{{ article.title | json }},"image":{{ article.image | img_url: 'master' | prepend: 'https:' | json }},"datePublished":{{ article.published_at | date: '%Y-%m-%d' | json }},"dateModified":{{ article.updated_at | date: '%Y-%m-%d' | json }},"author":{"@type":"Organization","name":"惠通行","url":"https://www.huitong1929.com"},"publisher":{"@type":"Organization","name":"惠穀實業有限公司","logo":{"@type":"ImageObject","url":"https://www.huitong1929.com/[YOUR_LOGO_PATH].png"}},"url":{{ shop.url | append: article.url | json }},"mainEntityOfPage":{"@type":"WebPage","@id":{{ shop.url | append: article.url | json }}}}</script>

breadcrumb_product._note: BreadcrumbList for 產品頁，可與 Product schema 合併在同一 <script> 標籤內（用 @graph）
